identity: RW Equipment Aggro built around the cube's entire Equipment & Vehicle package. The deck deploys a wide board of cheap bodies and token-pairs by turn 3, then inflates whichever attacker is unblocked with Vanquisher's Axe (+2/+0) or Hero's Heirloom (+2/+1). Baird, Argivian Recruiter converts that power-above-base condition into a free 1/1 Soldier at every end step, and Astor, Bearer of Blades reduces equip to {1} so a single Equipment relocates every turn and also grants Weatherlight Compleated the crew ability it does not natively have. Enlist is a supporting mechanic here, not the headline: after the Phase 9 repairs the list runs 3 enlist cards (Guardian of New Benalia, Yavimaya Steelcrusher, Argivian Cavalier x1), down from 5, and the deck was renamed accordingly. Astor (1 copy) and Baird (2 copies) are amplifiers, not assembly requirements: the declared assembly roles are payoff (the four Equipment plus Weatherlight, p=0.76 by turn 5) and enabler (15 bodies, p=1.00), neither of which routes through Astor. Note the bucket labels differ by design: Equipment are Threats/Payoffs in slot_allocation and payoff in assembly; the Engine bucket holds only Baird and Astor.

mainboard.name: Vanquisher's Axe
mainboard.oracle_text:
Equipped creature gets +2/+0.
Equip {2} ({2}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - Equipment, thesis carrier; castable T1 off {1}, Equip {2} (or {1} with Astor)

mainboard.name: Phoenix Chick
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
This creature can't block.
Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {R}{R}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with a +1/+1 counter on it.
mainboard.role: Threat - evasive haste clock and Equipment carrier; recurs from the graveyard for {R}{R} when attacking with three or more creatures

mainboard.name: Hero's Heirloom
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - Equipment, +2/+1. Defended on the +2/+1, NOT on the legendary trample/haste rider: only 3 of the 15 creature cards are legendary (Astor x1, Baird x2) per Challenger F7.

mainboard.name: Weatherlight Compleated
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
As long as Weatherlight Compleated has four or more phyresis counters on it, it's a Phyrexian creature in addition to its other types.
Whenever a creature you control dies, put a phyresis counter on Weatherlight Compleated. Then draw a card if it has seven or more phyresis counters on it. If it doesn't, scry 1.
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - Vehicle. Astor crew target and a mana-free repeating scry ('Whenever a creature you control dies... If it doesn't, scry 1'). Reliability-weighted to 0.5 in assembly: it has no printed crew ability.

mainboard.name: Baird, Argivian Recruiter
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power greater than its base power, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Engine - end-step 1/1 Soldier off any creature with power above base. Legendary, so copy 2 is removal insurance, not doubled throughput.

mainboard.name: Valiant Veteran
mainboard.oracle_text:
Other Soldiers you control get +1/+1.
{3}{W}{W}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - Soldier anthem; also switches Baird on with no attack required

mainboard.name: Guardian of New Benalia
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
Whenever this creature enlists a creature, scry 2.
Discard a card: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
mainboard.role: Threat/Enabler - enlist body; 'Whenever this creature enlists a creature, scry 2'

mainboard.name: Yavimaya Steelcrusher
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
{1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact.
mainboard.role: Threat/Interaction - enlist body; '{1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact'

mainboard.name: Resolute Reinforcements
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Enabler - two Soldier bodies for two mana at flash speed

mainboard.name: Lightning Strike
mainboard.oracle_text: Lightning Strike deals 3 damage to any target.
mainboard.role: Interaction - 3 damage to ANY target, so it doubles as reach to the face

mainboard.name: Argivian Cavalier
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.

mainboard.name: Cleaving Skyrider
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flash
Kicker {2}{R} (You may pay an additional {2}{R} as you cast this spell.)
Flying
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
mainboard.role: Threat/Reach - flash 2/2 flier (evasive Equipment carrier); kicked {2}{R} it 'deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of attacking creatures' - the deck's maindeck reach

mainboard.name: Keldon Strike Team
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{W} (You may pay an additional {1}{W} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
As long as this creature entered this turn, creatures you control have haste.
mainboard.role: Threat/Enabler - 3/1 whose haste clause is UNCONDITIONAL ('As long as this creature entered this turn, creatures you control have haste'), so it hastes the board even unkicked; kicked {1}{W} it additionally makes two 1/1 Soldiers. Corrected per Challenger F8.

mainboard.name: Citizen's Arrest
mainboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
mainboard.role: Interaction - unconditional exile of any creature or planeswalker, regardless of toughness

mainboard.name: Astor, Bearer of Blades
mainboard.oracle_text:
When Astor enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal an Equipment or Vehicle card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Equipment you control have equip {1}.
Vehicles you control have crew 1.
mainboard.role: Engine - equip {1}, crew 1, dig 7 for the package (5 physical targets in the list)

mainboard.name: Sacred Peaks
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {R} or {W}.)
This land enters tapped.

sideboard.name: Smash to Dust
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target creature with defender.
• Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
sideboard.role: SB - artifact removal; mode 3 is a one-sided mini-sweeper ('each creature your opponents control')

sideboard.name: Destroy Evil
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
sideboard.role: SB - enchantment removal / kills toughness-4-or-greater creatures

sideboard.name: Prayer of Binding
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
sideboard.role: SB - flash exile of any nonland permanent, +2 life

sideboard.name: Hurloon Battle Hymn
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
Hurloon Battle Hymn deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was kicked, you gain 4 life.
sideboard.role: SB - 4 damage to a creature/planeswalker; kicked {W} gains 4 life, the anti-race slot

sideboard.name: Take Up the Shield
sideboard.oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
sideboard.role: SB - indestructible + lifelink protects the equipped carrier from targeted removal; the +1/+1 counter is permanent, so it also satisfies Baird

sideboard.name: Anointed Peacekeeper
sideboard.oracle_text:
Vigilance
As this creature enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name.
Spells your opponents cast with the chosen name cost {2} more to cast.
Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
sideboard.role: SB - 3/3 vigilance body plus hand-inspection tax on the opponent's best card
